Next.js 15 + Prisma app with an existing Meta Pixel / CAPI / Google Ads tracking layer. Work ONLY in the git worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-mktg (NOT /opt/nxeon). Do NOT run git/npm build/prisma. Edit files only. Do NOT change any money/charge/order logic — the tracking calls are best-effort, fire-and-forget, and must never block or alter a purchase.

GOAL: Wire SIX distinct conversion events (each firing a Meta standard event AND, when a label is configured, a Google Ads conversion) at the right points in the funnel: (1) Sign up, (2) VPS deployed, (3) Shared hosting deployed, (4) Game server deployed, (5) Email deployed, (6) Credit card added. Labels come later (owner pastes them into settings); build so each Google conversion is INERT until its label setting is non-empty.

READ FIRST to learn the current pattern:
- `components/marketing/ConversionTags.tsx` — defines `window.nxTrack(evt, params)`. Currently: fires `fbq('track', evt, {...})` for any evt, and a Google Ads conversion ONLY when `evt==='Purchase'` (using `googleAdsId`/`googleAdsPurchaseLabel`).
- `lib/tracking.ts` — `loadTrackingConfig()` reads settings (meta_pixel_id, ga4_measurement_id, google_ads_id, google_ads_purchase_label, meta_capi_token). The config is passed to ConversionTags.
- `lib/settings.ts` — `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS` map (near `google_ads_purchase_label`).
- Existing callers of nxTrack: `components/marketing/PurchaseTracker.tsx` (fires `nxTrack('Purchase', ...)`), `components/customer/HostingDeployWizard.tsx` (fires `nxTrack('Subscribe', ...)` on hosting order success — around the `window.location.href = /dashboard/hosting/...` line).

IMPLEMENT:

1. **Settings** (`lib/settings.ts` SETTINGS_DEFAULTS): add six empty string labels next to `google_ads_purchase_label`:
   `google_ads_signup_label`, `google_ads_vps_label`, `google_ads_hosting_label`, `google_ads_game_label`, `google_ads_email_label`, `google_ads_card_label` — all default "".

2. **Tracking config** (`lib/tracking.ts`): load those six labels (via getSetting) and expose them on the client tracking config, e.g. a `googleAdsLabels` object `{ signup, vps, hosting, game, email, card, purchase }` (include the existing purchase label). Keep the existing fields.

3. **nxTrack refactor** (`components/marketing/ConversionTags.tsx`): change `nxTrack` to take an ACTION KEY and map it to a Meta standard event + a Google label. Build an in-script map:
   `{ signup:{m:'CompleteRegistration',g:labels.signup}, vps:{m:'Purchase',g:labels.vps}, hosting:{m:'Subscribe',g:labels.hosting}, game:{m:'Purchase',g:labels.game}, email:{m:'Subscribe',g:labels.email}, card:{m:'AddPaymentInfo',g:labels.card}, purchase:{m:'Purchase',g:labels.purchase} }`.
   `nxTrack(key, p)` should: fire `fbq('track', map[key].m, {value,currency,...}, eventId?{eventID}:undefined)`, and if `googleAdsId && map[key].g` fire `gtag('event','conversion',{send_to: googleAdsId+'/'+map[key].g, value:p.value, currency:p.currency||'USD', transaction_id:p.eventId||''})`. BACKWARD-COMPAT: if `key` is not in the map, fall back to the OLD behavior (treat key as a raw Meta event name for fbq, and fire Google only if key==='Purchase' with the purchase label) so nothing regresses. Keep the whole thing null-safe (guard on window.fbq / window.gtag existing).

4. **Fire at the six funnel points** — client-side, fire-and-forget (wrap in try/catch, cast `window as unknown as { nxTrack?: (k:string,p?:Record<string,unknown>)=>void }`). Use a stable eventId where one exists (e.g. an idempotency key) for dedup; else omit:
   - **signup**: find where account registration COMPLETES on the client (search `app/register`, `components/**Register**`, `signup`, `createAccount`, the auth/register form success handler). Fire `nxTrack('signup', {eventId})`.
   - **vps**: `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` — on a completed VPS order (the success/redirect after the order server action returns ok). Fire `nxTrack('vps', {value: <monthly or charge if in scope>, currency:'USD', eventId})`. If value isn't cleanly in scope, omit value.
   - **hosting**: `components/customer/HostingDeployWizard.tsx` — CHANGE the existing `nxTrack('Subscribe', ...)` call to `nxTrack('hosting', {...})` (same spot, same eventId).
   - **game**: `components/customer/GameDeployWizard.tsx` — on a completed game order success. Fire `nxTrack('game', {value?, currency:'USD', eventId})`.
   - **email**: `components/customer/EmailHosting.tsx` — on a successful email hosting order (the OrderPanel submit success, `res.ok`). Fire `nxTrack('email', {eventId})`.
   - **card**: card added. Two spots: (a) `HostingDeployWizard.tsx` where `finalizeCardSetup(sid)` returns `res.ok` (fire `nxTrack('card', {})`), and (b) the billing card-add finalize path (`lib/actions-payment-method.ts` is a server action, so fire from the CLIENT component that calls it / handles `?card_setup=` on `/dashboard/billing` — likely `components/customer/PaymentMethod.tsx`; fire `nxTrack('card', {})` on the client after a successful save).
   - **purchase**: update `PurchaseTracker.tsx` to call `nxTrack('purchase', ...)` instead of `nxTrack('Purchase', ...)` (so the paid-order Google purchase conversion uses the mapped label; keep the value/currency/eventId it already passes).

CONSTRAINTS: only tracking + the named flow components/settings. No money logic. Keep it typesafe + SSR-safe (nxTrack is a client global; guard access). Each Google conversion must stay INERT until its label setting is filled (empty label → no gtag conversion, just the Meta event).

REPORT (concise): every file changed; the exact firing point you wired for each of the 6 (signup/vps/hosting/game/email/card) + purchase; any firing point you could NOT confidently locate (say where you looked); confirm backward-compat for old nxTrack('Purchase')/('Subscribe') callers; confirm no money logic touched and each Google conversion is inert without a label.

5	// server components, server actions and the worker. Do NOT import from client
6	// components.
7	//
8	// Every admin-editable knob lives here with a default, so reads are total: a key
9	// that has never been written falls back to its SETTINGS_DEFAULTS value. Booleans
10	// are stored as the strings "true"/"false"; money is stored in cents; percents as
11	// plain numbers (e.g. "8.5" = 8.5%).
12	
13	import { db } from "./db";
14	import { VPS_TERMS } from "./billing-terms";
15	
16	export const SETTINGS_DEFAULTS = {
17	  // --- General / Branding ---
18	  //
19	  // Every default in this block is the string that was previously HARDCODED at the
20	  // render site it now feeds. That matters: `getSetting` falls back to these, so a
21	  // platform with an empty `Setting` table must render exactly what it rendered
22	  // before the wiring landed. A default of "" here would have blanked the footer
23	  // tagline and produced an empty `mailto:` on /contact the moment these keys were
24	  // read for the first time.
25	  brand_name: "Nxeon",

27	  // The footer is this key's only consumer, so the panel now previews what actually ships.

32	  // site published a real one — and reading the blank key would have shipped
33	  // `mailto:` with no recipient.

35	  // DNS zone that managed-Nextcloud (NxCloud) instances live under:
36	  // <subdomain>.<nxcloud_zone>. A wildcard *.nxcloud_zone → the instance VMs (or a
37	  // per-instance A record) must resolve for auto-TLS to issue. See worker/nxcloud.ts.
38	  nxcloud_zone: "nxcloud.nxeon.cloud",
39	  // Blank is legitimate for these two: `renderInvoiceHTML` omits the seller block

53	  // They do two jobs: they turn the homepage review badges into real links (a

57	  review_url_trustpilot: "",
58	  review_url_hostadvice: "",
59	  review_url_google: "",

No money/charge/order logic touched — every firing point is client-side, fire-and-forget, wrapped in try/catch, and a no-op until consent loads the pixel and a label is set.

### Files changed
1. **`lib/settings.ts`** — added 6 empty-string defaults next to `google_ads_purchase_label`: `google_ads_signup_label`, `_vps_`, `_hosting_`, `_game_`, `_email_`, `_card_label`.
2. **`lib/tracking.ts`** — added `GoogleAdsLabels` type; `loadTrackingConfig` now reads the 6 labels via `getSetting`; both `TrackingConfig` and `PublicTrackingConfig` expose a `googleAdsLabels` object `{signup,vps,hosting,game,email,card,purchase}` (purchase mirrors the existing purchase label); `toPublicConfig` forwards it. Existing fields kept.
3. **`components/marketing/ConversionTags.tsx`** — `nxTrack(key,p)` refactored to an action-key map (`signup→CompleteRegistration`, `vps→Purchase`, `hosting→Subscribe`, `game→Purchase`, `email→Subscribe`, `card→AddPaymentInfo`, `purchase→Purchase`). Map is built server-side and `JSON.stringify`-injected (label-injection safe). Fires `fbq('track', map.m, {value,currency}, eventId?{eventID}:undefined)`; fires Google `conversion` only when `googleAdsId && map.g` is non-empty. Null-safe (`if(window.fbq)`/`if(window.gtag)`). Backward-compat: unknown key → treated as raw Meta event name, Google fired only for `'Purchase'` with the purchase label.
4. **`components/marketing/PurchaseTracker.tsx`** — `nxTrack('Purchase',…)` → `nxTrack('purchase',…)`, same value/currency/eventId.

7. **`lib/actions.ts`** — `register()` success redirect changed `"/dashboard"` → `"/dashboard?signup=1"` (tracking marker only; no logic).
8. **`components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx`** — fires `nxTrack('vps',{value:dueCents/100,currency:'USD'})` in the `checkoutUrl` success effect.
9. **`components/customer/GameDeployWizard.tsx`** — fires `nxTrack('game',{value:dueCents/100,currency:'USD'})` in the `checkoutUrl` success effect.
10. **`components/customer/HostingDeployWizard.tsx`** — existing `nxTrack('Subscribe',…)` → `nxTrack('hosting',…)` (same spot, same `idemRef.current` eventId); also fires `nxTrack('card',{})` when `finalizeCardSetup(sid).ok`.
11. **`components/customer/EmailHosting.tsx`** — fires `nxTrack('email',{})` on `res.ok` in the OrderPanel submit.

### Exact firing point per event
- **signup**: server redirect `?signup=1` → `SignupTracker` on `/dashboard` (register is a server action with a server-side `redirect`, so there is no client success handler on the form itself — the marker is how completion becomes client-observable). No stable eventId → omitted.
- **vps**: `DeployWizard` `useEffect([state])` when `state.checkoutUrl && submittedRef.current` (order accepted → heading to checkout). value=`dueCents/100`. No idempotency key in scope → eventId omitted.
- **hosting**: `HostingDeployWizard.place()` success block (unchanged location), eventId=`idemRef.current`.
- **game**: `GameDeployWizard` `useEffect([state])` checkoutUrl success. value=`dueCents/100`. eventId omitted.
- **email**: `EmailHosting` OrderPanel `res.ok`. eventId omitted (no key available).
- **card**: (a) `HostingDeployWizard` `finalizeCardSetup(sid).ok`; (b) `PaymentMethod` `CardSetupReturn` `finalizeCardSetup(sessionId).ok`.
- **purchase**: `PurchaseTracker` now calls `nxTrack('purchase',…)`, keeping its existing value/currency/eventId (so the paid-order Google conversion uses the mapped purchase label).

### Confirmations
- **Backward-compat**: any legacy `nxTrack('Purchase')`/`('Subscribe')` caller still works — unknown keys fall back to raw-Meta-event behavior, and Google fires only for `'Purchase'` with the purchase label, exactly as before. (All in-repo callers were also migrated to the new keys.)
- **Inert without label**: every Google conversion is gated on `googleAdsId && map[key].g` (or, in fallback, `PLBL`); an empty label fires the Meta event only, no `gtag` conversion.
- **No money logic touched**: only tracking calls, settings keys, and the signup redirect marker were changed; all six calls are best-effort/non-blocking and never alter the order path.

### Things to flag
- **Could not cleanly locate a client success for signup and the wallet-path VPS/game orders**: `register()`, and the fully-wallet-covered/free VPS & game paths, all finish with a **server-side `redirect`** (`payAndDeploy`/`payAndDeployGame` → `redirect('/dashboard/servers/…')`), so those completions are not observable in the wizard's client. Signup is therefore wired via the `?signup=1` marker + dashboard tracker; **vps/game fire only on the card path** (the `checkoutUrl` return). I looked in `app/register`, `components/AuthForms.tsx`, `lib/actions.ts` (register/payAndDeploy), and `lib/actions-gameplans.ts`. Google-OAuth signups (account created in the OAuth callback route, not the form) are **not** wired — I left that out to stay in scope; if you want OAuth signups counted, the callback's new-account redirect would need the same `?signup=1` marker.
- **Meta double-count caveat (by design of the mapping)**: for a **card** VPS/game order, `vps`/`game` map to Meta `Purchase` and fire at checkout-start with no eventId, and after payment `purchase` also fires Meta `Purchase` (with the fulfil eventId). These won't dedupe, so Meta will see two Purchase events for one card VPS/game order. The Google side is unaffected (distinct conversion actions/labels). This follows the mapping you specified (`vps`/`game`→`Purchase`); flagging so you can decide whether to give vps/game a Meta event other than `Purchase` if the double-count matters.
